ov: About 1,000 species of long, snake-like fish, mostly marine. The freshwater eels of the genus Anguilla live in rivers but migrate to the sea to breed.

why.et: Freshwater eels (unagi) and sea eels are popular in Japanese and Chinese cooking.
why.ac: Most eels are nocturnal; the European eel feeds mainly at night, hunting by scent.

rg: Mostly seas; Anguilla eels live in rivers.
fx: European eels spawn in the Sargasso Sea and are now critically endangered.
